Job Purpose

As an infection control nurse, the main role of this position is to provide, implement and recommend infection control standard to all staffs as well to achieve the company’s mission of providing modern, comprehensive and safe environment to the customers.

Job Description
• Ensuring the development, implementation and evaluation of relevant standards of practice in Infection Control based on the Infection Guidelines provided by the Ministry of Health Malaysia (MOH), Centers of Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) & World Health Organization (WHO).

• Observation of surveillance trends to identify potential infectious hazards with its appropriate implementation of remedial strategies
• Review and follow up on any incidents pertaining to infection control to prevent or minimize incidences

• Able to assess and interpret information, e.g. microbiological results, assess risk and apply advice to local situation
